name: Catalog Heaven
desc:
Battle with any Roblox-made gear from the avatar marketplace! Or customize your avatar!

Defaults to R6 avatars since not all gear work with R15.

Developed by Seranok. Catalog UI by Quenty. Maps by Maelstronomer, Agenttech, duncan779, Shedletsky, and Merely. "You got bloxxed" interface by Mazux.
